symptom: `describe workflow` → `create or modify` → `describe` differs: a call microflow authored with `comment 'Summarise'` comes back captioned with the microflow's name (`-- ACT_Summarise`)
cause: `formatCallMicroflowTask` printed the caption only as a trailing `-- caption` MDL comment, which the parser discards; re-execution then fell back to the builder's default caption (the microflow's short name)
insight: A trailing `--` comment in describe output is documentation, not data — anything round-trippable must be a grammar clause. Emit `comment '…'` only when the caption differs from the derived default, matching jump/wait (issuetracker #16), so an unauthored caption does not start appearing as authored. Only an end-to-end describe → exec → describe with an AUTHORED caption catches it; fixtures without captions pass either way
